decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: Count Prague Metro D once as the named staged railway. Preserve the I.D1 operating subset and I.D2/I.D3 extensions without counting each station or construction contract again. Prague is a separately bounded municipal place; its tram, housing and utility examples remain contextual systems rather than further project additions in this group.

Count Prague once as the capital-city municipality, separate from the Metro D railway. District examples retain their local scope without being counted as additional municipalities. Regional transit coverage, shared utility networks and proposed mixed-use buildings do not extend the place boundary or create extra portfolio identities in this account.

Count Brno once within its municipal boundary. Keep heat supply chains, river-basin dependencies and regional travel as context without expanding that boundary. Brno-sever, the Trnitá flood stages and Medlánky depot illustrate local systems; none is separately added to the project inventory in this group, and individual city districts do not add place counts.

review_checks: Identity screening found no Prague Metro D, Prague municipality or Brno municipality in the current counted cohorts or historical eligibility/acquisition registries. One railway and two municipalities are added; construction lots, districts, depots and local works are not extra identities.

Nineteen official source records were inspected November 22: eighteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and one official indexed municipal housing record after a direct timeout. The April 7 contract announcement is distinct from the June 19 ceremony and work beginning that week. April 2022 retains month precision. CZK 29.99 billion excludes VAT and is a lot price, not final whole-line cost. Underlying contract, court and procurement decisions were not inspected as independent legal evidence.

The second-half 2032 forecast is not passenger operation. General schedule-page assumptions were not used to override the later June construction-start account; proposed southern/northern stations retain separate delivery stages.

Prague 5's three groups retain their separate age bands and listed capacities of 22, 22 and 10. These are not vacancies or a Prague-wide capacity denominator; the linked 2026/27 form was not tested.

PDS's redirected official Project 1 page separates September 2022 study approval, 2025 contracts and 2026 preparation. Mixed-use plans are not occupied homes. Brno-sever's October presentation is not the first day of operation. About 3,000 trial hours and 15,000 tonnes of operator-estimated avoided CO2 refer to the 2025/26 season and a gas comparator. Up to 38,000 tonnes annually is projected full-use potential, not measured annual output or lifecycle neutrality.

The CZK 1.815 billion grant decision is not disbursement; tree plans are not verified planting or survival, and the flood-design assumptions remain scoped.

Medlánky's May equipment completion and the November winter-preparation methods are separate from observed fleet downtime, cancellations and accessible-service outcomes. Plans for the coming winter are not a completed winter series.

All historical cohorts, 34 translated readings and evidence receipts remain intact. Linked files, PDFs, forms, maps and live services were not tested. Production acceptance, exact release authority, launch and thirty real operating days remain separate.
